description: This Java source file defines the ContentPermissionServices class, which provides service methods related to permission checks on Content entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to verify user permissions for content operations and content associations.

classes.name: ContentPermissionServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services to check permissions on Content entities, including user rights to perform operations and manage associations.

methods.name: checkContentPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform specified operations on a Content entity based on various criteria including content purpose, roles, and permissions.

methods.name: checkAssocPermission
methods.description: Verifies if a user has permission to create or modify an association between two Content entities, such as linking from one content to another.
